syllabus.note: Mapped to the uploaded PCCOE syllabus; not a universal SPPU syllabus for every engineering branch.

subjects.name: Linear Algebra & Univariate Calculus
subjects.description: Semester I · BSH31BS01 · matrices and differential equations

topics.name: Unit I · Matrices & Linear Algebra
topics.revision: Practise rank, solving linear systems, dependence, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

topics.name: Unit II · Differential Calculus
topics.revision: Revise Taylor/Maclaurin expansions, indeterminate forms and Leibniz theorem.

topics.name: Unit III · First-Order ODEs
topics.revision: Identify exact equations and model growth, decay and simple circuits.

topics.name: Unit IV · Higher-Order ODEs
topics.revision: Practise constant-coefficient equations and variation of parameters.

subjects.name: Engineering Physics
subjects.description: Semester I · BSH31BS03 · six syllabus units

topics.name: Unit I · Semiconductor Physics
topics.revision: Revise band theory, Hall effect, Fermi level, PN junctions and solar cells.

topics.name: Unit II · Lasers & Fiber Optics
topics.revision: Review stimulated emission, population inversion, numerical aperture and optical losses.

topics.name: Unit III · Quantum Mechanics
topics.revision: Practise de Broglie wavelength, uncertainty, Schrödinger equation and particle in a box.

topics.name: Unit IV · Quantum Computing
topics.revision: Review qubits, Bloch sphere, gates, superposition, entanglement and Bell states.

topics.name: Unit V · Magnetism & Superconductivity
topics.revision: Revise magnetic materials, hysteresis, Meissner effect and critical temperature.

topics.name: Unit VI · Nanoscience
topics.revision: Compare top-down and bottom-up synthesis and size-dependent properties.

subjects.name: Computational Thinking & Problem Solving
subjects.description: Semester I · BCE31ES01 · algorithms through real-world problem solving

topics.name: Unit I · Computational Thinking & Git
topics.revision: Practise decomposition, algorithms, flowcharts, pseudocode and version control.

topics.name: Unit II · Programming Fundamentals
topics.revision: Review data types, operators, input/output, compiler and interpreter.

topics.name: Unit III · Control, Functions & Data
topics.revision: Trace conditions, loops, recursion, lists, searching, sorting and files.

topics.name: Unit IV · APIs & Real-World Problems
topics.revision: Understand modular design, APIs, JSON and data handling.

subjects.name: Digital Electronics & Computer Organization
subjects.description: Semester I · BCE31ES02 · logic, sequential circuits and computer systems

topics.name: Unit I · Logic Gates & Minimization
topics.revision: Practise truth tables, Boolean forms, K-maps and don't-care conditions.

topics.name: Unit II · Combinational Logic
topics.revision: Review adders, subtractors, code converters, multiplexers and parity circuits.

topics.name: Unit III · Sequential Logic
topics.revision: Compare latches, flip-flops, registers and counter types.

topics.name: Unit IV · Computer Organization
topics.revision: Review buses, Von Neumann/Harvard models, instruction execution and I/O.

topics.name: Unit V · Memory & Processor Organization
topics.revision: Compare RAM/ROM, cache, storage, registers and multicore processors.

subjects.name: Constitution of India
subjects.description: Semester I · BSH31VE01 · constitutional foundations and institutions

topics.name: Constitution · Foundations
topics.revision: Review the Preamble, constitutional values and key features.

topics.name: Constitution · Rights & Duties
topics.revision: Distinguish Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles and Fundamental Duties.

topics.name: Constitution · Government Structure
topics.revision: Review legislature, executive, judiciary and federal structure.

subjects.name: Communicative English
subjects.description: Semester I · BSH31AE01 · comprehension, grammar and communication

topics.name: Communication · Listening & Reading
topics.revision: Practise identifying main ideas, evidence, purpose and implied meaning.

topics.name: Communication · Grammar & Vocabulary
topics.revision: Review sentence structure, subject-verb agreement and precise word choice.

topics.name: Communication · Writing & Presentations
topics.revision: Organize paragraphs, formal emails and clear presentation structures.

subjects.name: Life Skills 1
subjects.description: Semester I · BSH31CC01 · self-awareness and personal effectiveness

topics.name: Life Skills · Self-Awareness
topics.revision: Practise identifying strengths, values, emotions and learning goals.

topics.name: Life Skills · Communication & Teamwork
topics.revision: Review active listening, empathy, feedback and collaboration.

topics.name: Life Skills · Growth & Wellbeing
topics.revision: Apply goal-setting, reflection and responsible decision-making.

subjects.name: Multivariate Calculus
subjects.description: Semester II · BSH32BS12 · partial derivatives, series and multiple integrals

topics.name: Unit I · Partial Differentiation
topics.revision: Practise chain rule, Euler theorem, Jacobians and extrema.

topics.name: Unit II · Fourier Series
topics.revision: Review periodic functions, Dirichlet conditions and harmonic analysis.

topics.name: Unit III · Gamma, Beta & DUIS
topics.revision: Use Gamma/Beta identities and differentiation under the integral sign.

topics.name: Unit IV · Multiple Integrals
topics.revision: Practise double/triple integrals, polar conversion, area and volume.

subjects.name: Engineering Chemistry
subjects.description: Semester II · BSH32BS09 · chemistry concepts and engineering applications

topics.name: Unit I · AI & Computational Chemistry
topics.revision: Review molecular visualization, DFT, cheminformatics and responsible AI use.

topics.name: Unit II · Advanced Materials & Nanotechnology
topics.revision: Revise conducting/biodegradable polymers, graphene, CNTs and quantum dots.

topics.name: Unit III · Water Technology & Green Chemistry
topics.revision: Practise hardness, water softening, reverse osmosis and green chemistry.

topics.name: Unit IV · Corrosion Science
topics.revision: Review corrosion mechanisms, galvanic series and corrosion prevention.

topics.name: Unit V · Energy & Battery Technology
topics.revision: Practise calorific value, fuel combustion, batteries and fuel cells.

subjects.name: Object Oriented Programming
subjects.description: Semester II · BCE32ES01 · object-oriented programming fundamentals

topics.name: OOP · Classes & Objects
topics.revision: Review class, object, encapsulation, constructors and access control.

topics.name: OOP · Binding & Polymorphism
topics.revision: Distinguish static/dynamic binding and function/operator overloading.

topics.name: OOP · Exception Handling
topics.revision: Practise try, catch, multiple handlers and nested exception handling.

topics.name: OOP · Reuse & Design
topics.revision: Review inheritance and reuse concepts covered in introductory OOP.

subjects.name: Discrete Mathematics
subjects.description: Semester II · BCE32ES02 · counting, relations, graphs and algebraic structures

topics.name: Unit I · Counting Principles
topics.revision: Practise inclusion-exclusion and pigeonhole principle.

topics.name: Unit II · Relations & Closures
topics.revision: Review relation properties, closure and Warshall's algorithm.

topics.name: Unit III · Graph Theory
topics.revision: Practise graph properties, shortest paths and planar graph basics.

topics.name: Unit IV · Group Theory & Coding
topics.revision: Review groups, subgroups, rings, integral domains and fields.

subjects.name: Universal Human Values
subjects.description: Semester II · BSH32VE02 · harmony in self, family, society and nature

topics.name: Unit I · Value Education
topics.revision: Review self-exploration, natural acceptance and basic human aspirations.

topics.name: Unit II · Harmony in the Human Being
topics.revision: Distinguish needs of the Self and Body, self-regulation and health.

topics.name: Unit III · Family & Society
topics.revision: Apply trust, respect and harmony in human relationships.

topics.name: Unit IV · Nature & Professional Ethics
topics.revision: Review coexistence, four orders, ethical conduct and holistic technologies.

subjects.name: Indian Knowledge System
subjects.description: Semester II · BSH32IK02 · history, science, arts and sustainability

topics.name: Unit I · History & Development of IKS
topics.revision: Review knowledge transmission, Shruti-Smriti and ancient learning institutions.

topics.name: Unit II · Scientific & Technical Contributions
topics.revision: Recognize contributions to mathematics, astronomy, metallurgy and water systems.

topics.name: Unit III · Literature & Performing Arts
topics.revision: Review literature, oral traditions, Natya Shastra, music and festivals.

topics.name: Unit IV · Sustainability & Ecology
topics.revision: Apply traditional water conservation, agriculture and environmental knowledge.

subjects.name: Life Skills 2
subjects.description: Semester II · BSH32CC02 · continued personal and interpersonal development

topics.name: Life Skills · Reflection & Goals
topics.revision: Use reflection and specific goals to plan personal development.

topics.name: Life Skills · Collaboration
topics.revision: Choose constructive responses to conflict, feedback and shared work.

topics.name: Life Skills · Responsibility & Adaptability
topics.revision: Apply ethical decisions, resilience and adaptive problem-solving.

questions.text: For a matrix A with 3 rows and 4 columns, what is its order?
questions.explanation: Matrix order is rows × columns, so the order is 3 × 4.

questions.subject: math1
questions.text: A system has coefficient matrix A = [[1, 2], [2, 4]]. What is rank(A)?
questions.explanation: The second row is twice the first, so only one row is independent and rank(A) = 1.

questions.text: The Maclaurin series is a Taylor series expanded about which point?
questions.explanation: A Maclaurin series is a Taylor series centered at x = 0.
questions.source: Original StudySense practice item; aligned to the uploaded PCCOE FY B.Tech Computer Engineering Regulations 2026 syllabus (AY 2026–27).

questions.subject: math1
questions.text: Using the first two non-zero terms, eˣ near x = 0 is approximately:
questions.explanation: The Maclaurin expansion begins eˣ = 1 + x + x²/2! + …; the first two terms are 1 + x.
questions.source: Original StudySense practice item; aligned to the uploaded PCCOE FY B.Tech Computer Engineering Regulations 2026 syllabus (AY 2026–27).

questions.text: Concept check: A project requirement changes late in development. A responsible team should first:
options: assess impact, communicate the change and reprioritize
ignore the new requirement without discussion
questions.explanation: Impact assessment and transparent communication help a team adapt while managing constraints.
